title: A sprint's goal research story in a project with no research_checks gets a check and a touch in that project (second-project run)
goal: new sprint in a project whose research_checks is [] and which has no kb root gives the research story a check that passes on a No outside facts note and no kb/public/** touch, so check does not refuse it

run:
import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(t/'backlog.json').write_text(json.dumps({'item_dir':'_backlog','research_checks':[],'review_checks':[{'run':['python3','_tools/backlog.py','check']}]}))
run = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
n = run('new','sprint','--title','plant','--goal','a goal')
c = run('check')
touches = [x for f in (t/'_backlog').glob('ST-*.json') for x in (json.loads(f.read_text()).get('touches') or [])]
sys.exit(0 if n.returncode == 0 and c.returncode == 0 and not any(x.startswith('kb/public') for x in touches) else 1)
